leads.title: VP Operations
leads.subject: new lanes
leads.fact: Sample Freight Co: opened two new lanes into Texas (sample fact)
leads.email:
Hey Dana, since you just opened two lanes into Texas, are empty miles on the new routes showing up before the quarter closes?

New lanes usually add empty miles nobody sees until the numbers come in.

Northfield shows which lanes lose money from the TMS data you already have, live in 2 weeks.

Open to learning more?
